mission: GuiAgentLoopCore provides the core logic for bridging GUI frameworks and LLM agents, managing conversation flow, agent interactions, and state control.
target_users: Application Developers: Building LLM-powered applications with GUI interfaces
AI Agent Developers: Creating specialized agents for specific tasks
Framework Developers: Building new GUI backend implementations
AI Agents: Claude, Gemini, Codex, and other AI models working with this codebase
core_value: Reliable, type-safe, and extensible foundation for GUI-LLM integration with predictable state management and clear component boundaries.

core_functions.details: Interpreter component centralizes conversation flow, state management, and agent coordination
core_functions.example: interpreter_manager.py manages chat sessions and state transitions

core_functions.details: Enforce monotonic state transitions (INIT → RUNNING → STOP) through hard invariants
core_functions.example: change_state_running() ensures state transitions are monotonic

core_functions.details: Role-based agent system (AGENT_EXECUTOR, LLM_PLANNER, SUPERVISOR, etc.) with clear boundaries
core_functions.example: AgentName enum defines roles: AGENT_EXECUTOR, LLM_PLANNER, SUPERVISOR, THOUGHT, CREW

core_functions.details: Handle structured communication between users, systems, and agents
core_functions.example: MessageTypeEnum defines: MESSAGE, CODE, CONFIRMATION, CONSOLE, IMAGE, FUNCTION

core_functions.details: Enable multiple GUI framework implementations (Gradio, extensible to others)

in_scope: Conversation Flow Management: Centralize how conversations flow through the system
State Machine: Provide reliable state transitions with monotonic guarantees
Agent Coordination: Manage multiple specialized agents with clear roles
Message Processing: Handle structured communication between users, systems, and agents
Backend Abstraction: Enable multiple GUI framework implementations
Streaming Support: Unified handling of sync and async streaming responses
out_of_scope: UI Rendering: We don't handle UI component rendering (that's the backend's job)
LLM Execution: We don't directly execute LLM models (we delegate to agents)
Session Storage: We don't persist sessions to databases (that's application-level)
Authentication: We don't handle user authentication (we only ensure session uniqueness)
Network Protocols: We don't define network protocols (that's backend-specific)

design_philosophy: Correctness Over Convenience: We prioritize system correctness over developer convenience. Hard invariants cannot be bypassed.
Explicit Over Implicit: All state transitions, message types, and agent roles are explicitly defined. No magic behavior.
Small, Focused Components: Each component has a single, well-defined responsibility. Clear boundaries between components.
Testability: All behavior is testable. Hard invariants have automated tests.
Conceptual Integrity: All terminology is normalized and defined in a formal ontology. No ambiguity.

success_metrics.target: New applications can integrate GuiAgentLoopCore in < 1 hour
Zero state transition bugs in production
New agents can be added without core modifications
Zero runtime type errors in message handling
